EM-LKG-V4-P009.title: Count & Match
EM-LKG-V4-P009.objective: Count object groups and match each group to its numeral.
EM-LKG-V4-P009.child_thinking: I count the objects, remember the total, and find the same numeral.
EM-LKG-V4-P009.instruction: Count each group. Draw a line to the matching number.
EM-LKG-V4-P009.expected_response: Four lines connecting quantities 2, 4, 6 and 8 to the matching shuffled numerals.
EM-LKG-V4-P009.teacher_cue: Model counting one group and matching it to a numeral placed on a different row.
validation_gates: only object groups appear on the left
only numerals appear on the right
no answer line is pre-drawn except the model

EM-LKG-V4-P010.title: Count & Circle
EM-LKG-V4-P010.objective: Count a group and select the correct numeral.
EM-LKG-V4-P010.child_thinking: I touch each object once, say the total, and choose that numeral.
EM-LKG-V4-P010.instruction: Count each group. Circle the correct number.
EM-LKG-V4-P010.expected_response: One circled numeral below each of six countable groups.
EM-LKG-V4-P010.teacher_cue: Ask the child to touch each object once before looking at the choices.

EM-LKG-V4-P011.title: More or Less
EM-LKG-V4-P011.objective: Compare two quantities and identify more or less.
EM-LKG-V4-P011.child_thinking: I compare the two groups, then count to check.
EM-LKG-V4-P011.instruction: Look at each pair. Circle the group asked for.
EM-LKG-V4-P011.expected_response: One selected group in each comparison row.
EM-LKG-V4-P011.teacher_cue: Ask for an estimate first, then verify by counting.
validation_gates: same object type within each pair

EM-LKG-V4-P012.title: Equal Groups
EM-LKG-V4-P012.objective: Recognise pairs with the same quantity.
EM-LKG-V4-P012.child_thinking: I count both groups and decide whether they have the same number.
EM-LKG-V4-P012.instruction: Count both groups. Circle YES if they are equal. Circle NO if they are not.
EM-LKG-V4-P012.expected_response: YES, NO and YES for the three rows.
EM-LKG-V4-P012.teacher_cue: Count the left group, then check whether the right group has the same total.
validation_gates: one YES and one NO control per row
same object type within each row

EM-LKG-V4-P013.title: Missing Numbers
EM-LKG-V4-P013.objective: Complete forward number sequences with one missing numeral.
EM-LKG-V4-P013.child_thinking: I read the numbers in order and say what comes in the blank.
EM-LKG-V4-P013.instruction: Read each number sequence. Write the missing number.
EM-LKG-V4-P013.expected_response: 3, 7 and 14 written in the three blanks.

illustration_assets.carrier_1: five plain stepping stones without numerals
illustration_assets.carrier_2: five plain train carriages without numerals

EM-LKG-V4-P013.teacher_cue: Read forward and pause at the blank without supplying the answer.

EM-LKG-V4-P014.title: Join Groups
EM-LKG-V4-P014.objective: Understand addition by combining two groups.
EM-LKG-V4-P014.child_thinking: I count each part, join both parts, and count the total.
EM-LKG-V4-P014.instruction: Count both groups. Add them and circle the total.
EM-LKG-V4-P014.expected_response: 3, 5 and 6 selected for the three problems.
EM-LKG-V4-P014.teacher_cue: Sweep both groups together with a finger before counting the total.
validation_gates: same object type within each problem

EM-LKG-V4-P015.title: Take Away
EM-LKG-V4-P015.objective: Understand subtraction by removing objects from a set.
EM-LKG-V4-P015.child_thinking: I count the starting set, cross out what is taken away, and count what remains.
EM-LKG-V4-P015.instruction: Count the set. Cross out the objects taken away. Circle how many remain.
EM-LKG-V4-P015.expected_response: 3, 3 and 3 selected after crossing out the specified objects.

illustration_assets.set_5_apples: five apples with the final two spaced apart
illustration_assets.set_4_fish: four fish with the final one spaced apart
illustration_assets.set_6_balloons: six balloons with the final three spaced apart

EM-LKG-V4-P015.teacher_cue: Cross out only the separated end objects, then recount the untouched objects.
validation_gates: removed objects remain visible under strike marks
subtraction is not represented by cropping

EM-LKG-V4-P016.title: Before & After
EM-LKG-V4-P016.objective: Identify the numeral immediately before and after a given numeral.
EM-LKG-V4-P016.child_thinking: I say the counting sequence around the middle number.
EM-LKG-V4-P016.instruction: Write the number before and the number after.
EM-LKG-V4-P016.teacher_cue: Say three numbers around the centre number, leaving the two answers for the child.

EM-LKG-V4-P017.title: Number Order
EM-LKG-V4-P017.objective: Arrange numerals from smallest to greatest.
EM-LKG-V4-P017.child_thinking: I find the smallest numeral first and continue counting forward.
EM-LKG-V4-P017.instruction: Write each set in order from smallest to greatest.
EM-LKG-V4-P017.teacher_cue: Find the smallest numeral first, then count forward.
validation_gates: tokens and answer slots are separate
token order differs from answer order

EM-LKG-V4-P018.title: Number Line
EM-LKG-V4-P018.objective: Use forward jumps on a number line.
EM-LKG-V4-P018.child_thinking: I start at the marked numeral and count one numeral for each jump.
EM-LKG-V4-P018.instruction: Start at the marked number. Follow the jumps. Circle where you land.
EM-LKG-V4-P018.expected_response: 2, 4 and 5 selected for the three number lines.
EM-LKG-V4-P018.teacher_cue: Point to the start and say one numeral for each arc.

EM-LKG-V4-P019.title: Compare Numbers
EM-LKG-V4-P019.objective: Compare the values of two numerals.
EM-LKG-V4-P019.child_thinking: The numeral that comes later when counting is greater.
EM-LKG-V4-P019.instruction: Circle the greater number in each row.
EM-LKG-V4-P019.teacher_cue: Ask which numeral comes later in the counting sequence.

EM-LKG-V4-P020.title: Math Stories
EM-LKG-V4-P020.objective: Solve simple addition and subtraction picture stories.
EM-LKG-V4-P020.child_thinking: I notice what changed, then count what there is now.

model_example.story: One bird is sitting. One more bird joins.

EM-LKG-V4-P020.instruction: Look at each picture story. Count and circle the answer.
EM-LKG-V4-P020.expected_response: 3, 3 and 2 selected for the three stories.

illustration_assets.story_ducks: two ducks in a pond and one duck joining
illustration_assets.story_balls: one ball on the ground and two more balls arriving
illustration_assets.story_biscuits: three biscuits on a plate with one being taken away by position only

EM-LKG-V4-P020.teacher_cue: Ask what happened first, what changed, and what must be counted now.
validation_gates: choices are adjacent to the story

EM-LKG-V4-P021.title: 2D Shapes
EM-LKG-V4-P021.objective: Match basic 2D shapes to familiar objects with the same shape.
EM-LKG-V4-P021.child_thinking: I look at the outline of the shape and find an object with the same outline.
EM-LKG-V4-P021.instruction: Match each shape to the object with the same shape.
EM-LKG-V4-P021.teacher_cue: Trace the shape outline in the air before matching it to an object.
